messages:
maya: heads-up: canary lotus11b-int4 on prod-dedicated is seeing a cluster of OOMs and p95 spikes since 03:10 UTC. pattern: requests with max_new_tokens >= 1024 or long streaming sessions.
arjun: saw it. stack traces point at KV alloc growth then OOM. can you paste route config and a couple of logs?
maya: route: /v1/generate?model=lotus11b-int4&route=lotus-canary
config:
```
batching: {max_batch_tokens: 4096, max_batch_size: 8}
prefetch_window: 0.8
kv_prefetch: true
max_new_tokens_default: 1024
quant: int4
kv_evict_policy: lru
```
logs:
```
[03:12:05] alloc_kv 45MB -> 512MB
[03:12:05] evict_kv: none (pinned)
[03:12:06] OOM: GPU0 out of memory while allocating 128MB
[03:12:06] trace: allocate_kv_chunk(size=134217728) at serve/runtime/kv_manager.cc:412
```
tess: weird that evict_kv == none (pinned). canary uses pinned slices? prefetch could be pinning KV chunks. arjun any quick mitigation to stop the OOMs?
arjun: quick mitigations i can flip now:
- lower max_new_tokens_default -> 256 for canary
- reduce prefetch_window -> 0.5
- enable kv_trim_on_alloc = true (soft trim before big alloc)
- cap max_batch_size -> 4
- add fallback route to lotus11b-fp16 if int4 fails
I can push an emergency config change and rollback if it doesn't help within 10m.
maya: applying now. curl command i used:
```
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/routes/lotus-canary/config -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"max_new_tokens_default":256,"prefetch_window":0.5,"max_batch_size":4}'
```
infra-bot: deploy started by maya
infra-bot: deploy succeeded in 18s
maya: after tweak, 10m in: p95 down from ~980ms -> ~410ms, and no new OOM events in the last 12m. still seeing memory churn and occasional small spikes on long sessions.
leon: fwiw hypothesis: int4 kernel allocation pattern + page alignment leads to fragmentation: repeated big KV allocations leave small unusable gaps. compaction between sessions (or after idle) would help.
sasha: can we add kv_compact_on_idle with idle_timeout=30s? that would shrink and defrag after chat sessions finish.
arjun: agree. also we should add a stress test that runs many sequential sessions with max_new_tokens=1024 to reproduce fragmentation. i'll open an issue and hook it into the canary CI.
maya: noted. action items:
- arjun: add test + issue (#4867)
- tess: PR to lower defaults in model-catalog for lotus11b-int4
- leon: prototype kv_compact_on_idle + metrics
- maya: monitor for 24h then decide promote or rollback
evals-bot: regression-alert: quality metrics stable vs baseline for lotus11b-int4 (delta: -0.2% on eval set, within noise).
tess: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3124 - lowers defaults and documents the canary tweak.
arjun: linked test run: https://ci.internal/builds/1245 - stress scenario passes under new defaults (no OOM after 500 sequential sessions).
maya: thanks all — will keep thread open 24h. closing for now unless OOMs recur. :thumbsup:
